title: Growth wrapper semantic-role gate prototype
principle: Apply conservative eligibility gates before auto_priority sorting. Do not rewrite wrapper text or generate new wrappers.

wrapper_rules.rationale: 「問う」は内側が質問として読める場合だけ自動候補にする。
決定内容の証拠がない文を自動で「決めた」で包まない。
反応外枠は反応sceneに限定する。
理由化外枠は理由sceneに限定する。
記録・同定外枠は状況sceneに限定する。
読解・記述・認定・告知・応答は引用・伝聞familyで自動候補にする。

context_detection.dimension_source: growth narrative family dimension when growth_family is known
context_detection.unknown_context_policy: specialized wrappers requiring a dimension are not auto-selected; broad fallback wrappers remain available

invariants: Noun-collision filtering runs first and remains unchanged.
Strict palindrome structure is inherited from existing sentence-level wrappers.
Manual wrapper selection is not restricted by this research prototype.
The gate affects automatic selection only.
A wrapper rejected by the gate is not deleted from growth-engine data.
success_criteria: Every one of the 45 narrative family final-stage contexts retains at least five eligible wrappers after noun-collision and role gating.
ask/ask-topic is absent from declarative auto pools unless interrogative evidence exists.
reaction wrappers are absent from non-反応 dimensions.
specialized quotation wrappers are absent from non-引用・伝聞 dimensions.
No existing growth reading is changed.
